def strip_comments(src):
    out=[]; i=0; n=len(src); state=None
    while i<n:
        c=src[i]
        if state:
            out.append(c)
            if c == '\\' and i+1<n:
                out.append(src[i+1]); i+=2; continue
            if c == state: state=None
            i+=1; continue
        if c in ('"',"'"):
            state=c; out.append(c); i+=1; continue
        if c=='/' and i+1<n and src[i+1]=='/':
            out.extend('  '); i+=2
            while i<n and src[i] != '\n': out.append(' '); i+=1
            continue
        if c=='/' and i+1<n and src[i+1]=='*':
            out.extend('  '); i+=2
            while i+1<n and not (src[i]=='*' and src[i+1]=='/'):
                out.append('\n' if src[i]=='\n' else ' '); i+=1
            if i+1<n: out.extend('  '); i+=2
            continue
        out.append(c); i+=1
    return ''.join(out)

def find_matching(s, open_idx, open_ch='{', close_ch='}'):
    depth=0; i=open_idx; n=len(s); state=None
    while i<n:
        c=s[i]
        if state:
            if c=='\\': i+=2; continue
            if c==state: state=None
            i+=1; continue
        if c in ('"',"'"):
            state=c; i+=1; continue
        if c==open_ch: depth+=1
        elif c==close_ch:
            depth-=1
            if depth==0: return i
        i+=1
    return None

def split_top(s, sep=','):
    res=[]; start=0; par=br=brace=0; state=None; i=0
    while i<len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if state:
            if c=='\\': i+=2; continue
            if c==state: state=None
        else:
            if c in ('"',"'"): state=c
            elif c=='(': par+=1
            elif c==')': par-=1
            elif c=='[': br+=1
            elif c==']': br-=1
            elif c=='{': brace+=1
            elif c=='}': brace-=1
            elif c==sep and par==0 and br==0 and brace==0:
                res.append(s[start:i]); start=i+1
        i+=1
    res.append(s[start:])
    return res

def split_words(s):
    words=[]; cur=[]; par=br=0; state=None; i=0
    while i<len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if state:
            cur.append(c)
            if c=='\\' and i+1<len(s): cur.append(s[i+1]); i+=2; continue
            if c==state: state=None
        else:
            if c in ('"',"'"):
                state=c; cur.append(c)
            elif c=='(': par+=1; cur.append(c)
            elif c==')': par-=1; cur.append(c)
            elif c=='[': br+=1; cur.append(c)
            elif c==']': br-=1; cur.append(c)
            elif c.isspace() and par==0 and br==0:
                if cur: words.append(''.join(cur)); cur=[]
            else: cur.append(c)
        i+=1
    if cur: words.append(''.join(cur))
    return words

def top_level_items(body, base_offset=0):
    items=[]; i=0; n=len(body)
    while i<n:
        while i<n and body[i].isspace(): i+=1
        if i>=n: break
        start=i; par=br=0; state=None
        while i<n:
            c=body[i]
            if state:
                if c=='\\': i+=2; continue
                if c==state: state=None
                i+=1; continue
            if c in ('"',"'"):
                state=c; i+=1; continue
            if c=='(': par+=1
            elif c==')': par-=1
            elif c=='[': br+=1
            elif c==']': br-=1
            elif c==';' and par==0 and br==0:
                items.append((body[start:i+1], base_offset+start)); i+=1; break
            elif c=='{' and par==0 and br==0:
                end=find_matching(body,i,'{','}')
                if end is None:
                    items.append((body[start:], base_offset+start)); i=n; break
                j=end+1
                while j<n and body[j].isspace(): j+=1
                if j<n and body[j]==';': j+=1
                items.append((body[start:j], base_offset+start)); i=j; break
            i+=1
        else:
            if body[start:].strip(): items.append((body[start:], base_offset+start))
    return items

def strip_initializer(stmt):
    parts=split_top(stmt, '=')
    return parts[0]

def parse_mapping(t):
    t=t.strip()
    if not t.startswith('mapping'):
        return None
    p=t.find('(')
    if p<0: return None
    q=find_matching(t,p,'(',')')
    if q is None: return None
    inside=t[p+1:q]
    # split on top-level =>
    par=br=0; idx=-1; i=0
    while i < len(inside)-1:
        c=inside[i]
        if c=='(': par+=1
        elif c==')': par-=1
        elif c=='[': br+=1
        elif c==']': br-=1
        elif c=='=' and inside[i+1]=='>' and par==0 and br==0:
            idx=i; break
        i+=1
    if idx<0: return None
    return inside[:idx].strip(), inside[idx+2:].strip()

class Contract:
    def __init__(self, source, kind, name, bases, body, body_offset, key):
        self.source=source; self.kind=kind; self.name=name; self.bases=bases; self.body=body; self.body_offset=body_offset; self.key=key
        self.structs={}; self.enums={}; self.own=[]; self.index=0

class SourceUnit:
    def __init__(self, path, display, content):
        self.path=path; self.display=display; self.content=content; self.stripped=strip_comments(content); self.contracts=[]; self.aliases={}

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, sources):
        self.sources=sources
        self.contracts_by_name={}
        self.contracts_by_key={}
        self.aliases={}
        self.contract_names=set()

    def collect(self):
        for su in self.sources:
            for m in re.finditer(r'\btype\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s+is\s+([^;]+);', su.stripped):
                su.aliases[m.group(1)] = m.group(2).strip()
                self.aliases[m.group(1)] = m.group(2).strip()
            for m in re.finditer(r'\b(contract|interface|library)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)([^{};]*)\{', su.stripped):
                kind,name,rest=m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3)
                open_idx=m.end()-1
                close=find_matching(su.stripped,open_idx,'{','}')
                if close is None:
                    raise Diagnostic("expected contract item (function, variable, struct, or modifier definition), found `<eof>`", su.display, max(0,len(su.content)-1), len(su.content), su.content, note="for a full list of valid contract items, see <https://docs.soliditylang.org/en/latest/grammar.html#a4.SolidityParser.contractBodyElement>")
                bases=[]
                bm=re.search(r'\bis\b(.+)', rest)
                if bm:
                    for b in split_top(bm.group(1)):
                        bw=split_words(b.strip())
                        if bw:
                            bases.append(re.split(r'\(', bw[0])[0])
                body=su.stripped[open_idx+1:close]
                c=Contract(su,kind,name,bases,body,open_idx+1,f"{su.display}:{name}")
                su.contracts.append(c)
                self.contracts_by_name.setdefault(name,c)
                self.contracts_by_key[c.key]=c
                self.contract_names.add(name)
        for c in list(self.contracts_by_key.values()):
            self.parse_contract(c)

    def parse_contract(self,c):
        items=top_level_items(c.body,c.body_offset)
        # First pass structs/enums
        for item,off in items:
            st=item.strip()
            if st.startswith('struct '):
                m=re.match(r'struct\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\{(.*)\}\s*;?\s*$', st, re.S)
                if m:
                    fields=[]
                    for f in split_top(m.group(2), ';'):
                        f=f.strip()
                        if not f: continue
                        words=split_words(f)
                        if len(words)>=2:
                            fields.append((' '.join(words[:-1]), words[-1]))
                    c.structs[m.group(1)]=fields
            elif st.startswith('enum '):
                m=re.match(r'enum\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\{(.*?)\}', st, re.S)
                if m:
                    vals=[x.strip() for x in m.group(2).split(',') if x.strip()]
                    c.enums[m.group(1)] = max(1,len(vals))
        # Second pass ABI items
        idx=0
        for item,off in items:
            st=item.strip()
            if not st or st.startswith(('struct ','enum ','modifier ','using ','pragma ','import ')):
                continue
            try:
                made = self.parse_item(c, st, off)
                for abi in made:
                    abi['_idx']=idx; idx+=1; c.own.append(abi)
            except Diagnostic:
                raise
            except Exception:
                # Silently skip syntax we do not model; Solar's parser accepts much more than this shim.
                pass

    def parse_item(self,c,st,off):
        if st.startswith('event '):
            m=re.match(r'event\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(', st)
            if not m: return []
            p=st.find('(',m.end()-1); q=find_matching(st,p,'(',')')
            params=self.parse_params(st[p+1:q], c, event=True)
            return [{"type":"event","name":m.group(1),"inputs":params,"anonymous": bool(re.search(r'\banonymous\b', st[q+1:]))}]
        if st.startswith('error '):
            m=re.match(r'error\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(', st)
            if not m: return []
            p=st.find('(',m.end()-1); q=find_matching(st,p,'(',')')
            return [{"type":"error","name":m.group(1),"inputs":self.parse_params(st[p+1:q], c)}]
        if st.startswith('constructor'):
            p=st.find('('); q=find_matching(st,p,'(',')')
            rest=st[q+1:]
            return [{"type":"constructor","inputs":self.parse_params(st[p+1:q], c),"stateMutability":"payable" if re.search(r'\bpayable\b', rest) else "nonpayable"}]
        if st.startswith('receive'):
            return [{"type":"receive","stateMutability":"payable" if re.search(r'\bpayable\b', st) else "nonpayable"}]
        if st.startswith('fallback'):
            return [{"type":"fallback","stateMutability":"payable" if re.search(r'\bpayable\b', st) else "nonpayable"}]
        if st.startswith('function '):
            return self.parse_function(c,st,off)
        return self.parse_variable(c,st)

    def parse_function(self,c,st,off):
        m=re.match(r'function\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(', st)
        if not m: return []
        name=m.group(1); p=st.find('(', m.start()); q=find_matching(st,p,'(',')')
        params=st[p+1:q]
        rest=st[q+1:]
        vis = re.search(r'\b(public|external|private|internal)\b', rest)
        if not vis and c.kind != 'interface':
            start = off + st.find('function')
            end = start + len(st.split('{',1)[0].strip())
            raise Diagnostic("no visibility specified", c.source.display, start, min(end, len(c.source.content)), c.source.content, help_msg="add `public` to the declaration")
        if vis and vis.group(1) in ('private','internal'):
            return []
        sm='nonpayable'
        if re.search(r'\bpayable\b', rest): sm='payable'
        elif re.search(r'\bpure\b', rest): sm='pure'
        elif re.search(r'\b(view|constant)\b', rest): sm='view'
        outputs=[]
        rm=re.search(r'\breturns\s*\(', rest)
        if rm:
            rp=rest.find('(', rm.start()); rq=find_matching(rest,rp,'(',')')
            if rq is not None: outputs=self.parse_params(rest[rp+1:rq], c)
        return [{"type":"function","name":name,"inputs":self.parse_params(params,c),"outputs":outputs,"stateMutability":sm}]

    def parse_variable(self,c,st):
        if '(' in st.split(';',1)[0] and not st.strip().startswith('mapping'):
            return []
        decl=strip_initializer(st).strip().rstrip(';').strip()
        words=split_words(decl)
        if 'public' not in words: return []
        mods={'public','private','internal','constant','immutable','override','transient'}
        try: first_mod=min(i for i,w in enumerate(words) if w in mods)
        except ValueError: return []
        if first_mod == 0 or not words: return []
        name=None
        for w in reversed(words[first_mod+1:]):
            if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*', w) and w not in mods:
                name=w; break
        if not name: return []
        type_str=' '.join(words[:first_mod])
        inputs, outputs = self.getter_io(type_str,c)
        return [{"type":"function","name":name,"inputs":inputs,"outputs":outputs,"stateMutability":"view"}]

    def parse_params(self,s,c,event=False):
        res=[]
        for part in split_top(s):
            part=part.strip()
            if not part: continue
            indexed=False
            words=split_words(part)
            if event and 'indexed' in words:
                indexed=True; words=[w for w in words if w!='indexed']
            # remove data locations and parameter-only modifiers
            filtered=[]
            for w in words:
                if w in ('memory','calldata','storage'):
                    continue
                filtered.append(w)
            words=filtered
            if not words: continue
            name=''
            type_words=words
            last=words[-1]
            if len(words)>=2 and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*', last) and last not in ('payable',):
                # Most two-token declarations have a name; single-token declarations are unnamed.
                type_words=words[:-1]; name=last
            type_str=' '.join(type_words)
            entry=self.abi_param(type_str,c,name)
            if event:
                # event key order: name,type,indexed,internalType,(components)
                new={"name":entry.get('name',''),"type":entry['type'],"indexed":indexed,"internalType":entry['internalType']}
                if 'components' in entry: new['components']=entry['components']
                entry=new
            res.append(entry)
        return res

    def abi_param(self,type_str,c,name=''):
        info=self.canonical_type(type_str,c)
        d={"name":name,"type":info['type'],"internalType":info['internalType']}
        if info.get('components') is not None:
            d['components']=info['components']
        return d

    def canonical_type(self,type_str,c):
        t=' '.join(type_str.strip().split())
        t=re.sub(r'\s*\[\s*([^\]]*)\s*\]', lambda m:'['+m.group(1).strip()+']', t)
        # array suffix
        suffix=''
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'(\[[^\]]*\])\s*$', t)
            if not m: break
            suffix=m.group(1)+suffix
            t=t[:m.start()].strip()
        if t in ('uint','int'):
            base=t+'256'; internal=base
            return {"type":base+suffix,"internalType":internal+suffix}
        if re.fullmatch(r'u?int\d+', t):
            return {"type":t+suffix,"internalType":t+suffix}
        if re.fullmatch(r'bytes\d+', t) or t in ('bool','address','string','bytes'):
            return {"type":t+suffix,"internalType":t+suffix}
        if t == 'address payable':
            return {"type":"address"+suffix,"internalType":"address payable"+suffix}
        if t in c.structs:
            comps=[self.abi_param(ft,c,fn) for ft,fn in c.structs[t]]
            return {"type":"tuple"+suffix,"internalType":f"struct {c.name}.{t}"+suffix,"components":comps}
        if '.' in t:
            short=t.split('.')[-1]
            owner=t.split('.')[0]
            cc=self.contracts_by_name.get(owner,c)
            if short in cc.structs:
                comps=[self.abi_param(ft,cc,fn) for ft,fn in cc.structs[short]]
                return {"type":"tuple"+suffix,"internalType":f"struct {owner}.{short}"+suffix,"components":comps}
            if short in cc.enums:
                return {"type":"uint8"+suffix,"internalType":f"enum {owner}.{short}"+suffix}
        if t in c.enums:
            return {"type":"uint8"+suffix,"internalType":f"enum {c.name}.{t}"+suffix}
        if t in self.aliases:
            base=self.canonical_type(self.aliases[t],c)
            return {"type":base['type']+suffix,"internalType":t+suffix}
        if t in self.contract_names:
            return {"type":"address"+suffix,"internalType":f"contract {t}"+suffix}
        # Unknown user type: Solidity contract/interface types ABI-encode as address in many common cases.
        if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*', t):
            return {"type":"address"+suffix,"internalType":f"contract {t}"+suffix}
        return {"type":t.replace(' ','')+suffix,"internalType":t+suffix}

    def getter_io(self,type_str,c):
        inputs=[]
        def rec(t):
            mp=parse_mapping(t)
            if mp:
                k,v=mp
                inputs.append(self.abi_param(k,c,''))
                return rec(v)
            # array public getter indexes one dimension, except bytes/string are scalar
            arr_suffixes=[]; base=t.strip()
            while True:
                m=re.search(r'(\[[^\]]*\])\s*$', base)
                if not m: break
                arr_suffixes.append(m.group(1)); base=base[:m.start()].strip()
            if arr_suffixes and base not in ('bytes','string'):
                inputs.append(self.abi_param('uint256',c,''))
                # public getter returns element with one dimension removed
                return rec(base + ''.join(reversed(arr_suffixes[1:])))
            info=self.canonical_type(t,c)
            if info['type'].startswith('tuple') and info.get('components'):
                return [comp.copy() for comp in info['components']]
            return [self.abi_param(t,c,'')]
        return inputs, rec(type_str)

    def inherited_items(self,c,seen=None):
        if seen is None: seen=set()
        if c.name in seen: return []
        seen.add(c.name)
        items=[]
        for b in c.bases:
            bc=self.contracts_by_name.get(b)
            if bc:
                items.extend(self.inherited_items(bc,seen))
                for it in bc.own:
                    if it['type'] != 'constructor': items.append(it)
        items.extend(c.own)
        # Dedupe identical ABI items, keeping later overrides for functions by signature.
        out=[]; seen_keys=set()
        for it in reversed(items):
            key=self.item_key(it)
            if key in seen_keys: continue
            seen_keys.add(key); out.append(it)
        return list(reversed(out))

    def item_key(self,it):
        if it['type']=='function': return ('function', it['name'], tuple(sig_type(x) for x in it.get('inputs',[])))
        if it['type'] in ('event','error'): return (it['type'], it.get('name'), tuple(sig_type(x) for x in it.get('inputs',[])))
        return (it['type'],)

    def abi_for(self,c):
        items=self.inherited_items(c)
        cats={'constructor':[], 'error':[], 'event':[], 'fallback':[], 'function':[], 'receive':[]}
        for it in items:

            cats.get(clean['type'],[]).append((it.get('_idx',0),clean))
        result=[]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['constructor'], key=lambda p:p[0])]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['error'], key=lambda p:(p[1].get('name',''), p[0]))]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['event'], key=lambda p:(p[1].get('name',''), p[0]))]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['fallback'], key=lambda p:p[0])]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['function'], key=lambda p:(p[1].get('name',''), p[0]))]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['receive'], key=lambda p:p[0])]
        return result

    def hashes_for(self,c):
        h={}
        for it in self.abi_for(c):
            if it.get('type') != 'function': continue
            sig=it['name']+'('+','.join(sig_type(x) for x in it.get('inputs',[]))+')'
            h[sig]=keccak256(sig.encode()).hex()[:8]

        return '('+','.join(sig_type(c) for c in param.get('components',[]))+')'+suffix

    for pref,target in opts.remappings:

    for c in cands:

    stripped=strip_comments(src)
    for m in re.finditer(r'\bimport\s+(?:(?:[^;]*?)\s+from\s+)?["\']([^"\']+)["\']', stripped):

    return OrderedDict([('contracts',contracts),('version',VERSION)])

    try:

        if opts.emit:
            text=json.dumps(result, indent=2 if opts.pretty_json else None, separators=None if opts.pretty_json else (',',':'))

                    raise Diagnostic(f"failed to write to output: {e.strerror} (os error {e.errno})")
            else:
                sys.stdout.write(text)
        return 0
    except Diagnostic as d:
        emit_diagnostics([d], opts)
        return 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

        if a == '--error-format-human' or a.startswith('--error-format-human='):

        if a == '--diagnostic-width' or a.startswith('--diagnostic-width='):

def strip_comments(src):
    out=[]; i=0; n=len(src); state=None
    while i<n:
        c=src[i]
        if state:
            out.append(c)
            if c == '\\' and i+1<n:
                out.append(src[i+1]); i+=2; continue
            if c == state: state=None
            i+=1; continue
        if c in ('"',"'"):
            state=c; out.append(c); i+=1; continue
        if c=='/' and i+1<n and src[i+1]=='/':
            out.extend('  '); i+=2
            while i<n and src[i] != '\n': out.append(' '); i+=1
            continue
        if c=='/' and i+1<n and src[i+1]=='*':
            out.extend('  '); i+=2
            while i+1<n and not (src[i]=='*' and src[i+1]=='/'):
                out.append('\n' if src[i]=='\n' else ' '); i+=1
            if i+1<n: out.extend('  '); i+=2
            continue
        out.append(c); i+=1
    return ''.join(out)

def find_matching(s, open_idx, open_ch='{', close_ch='}'):
    depth=0; i=open_idx; n=len(s); state=None
    while i<n:
        c=s[i]
        if state:
            if c=='\\': i+=2; continue
            if c==state: state=None
            i+=1; continue
        if c in ('"',"'"):
            state=c; i+=1; continue
        if c==open_ch: depth+=1
        elif c==close_ch:
            depth-=1
            if depth==0: return i
        i+=1
    return None

def split_top(s, sep=','):
    res=[]; start=0; par=br=brace=0; state=None; i=0
    while i<len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if state:
            if c=='\\': i+=2; continue
            if c==state: state=None
        else:
            if c in ('"',"'"): state=c
            elif c=='(': par+=1
            elif c==')': par-=1
            elif c=='[': br+=1
            elif c==']': br-=1
            elif c=='{': brace+=1
            elif c=='}': brace-=1
            elif c==sep and par==0 and br==0 and brace==0:
                res.append(s[start:i]); start=i+1
        i+=1
    res.append(s[start:])
    return res

def split_words(s):
    words=[]; cur=[]; par=br=0; state=None; i=0
    while i<len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if state:
            cur.append(c)
            if c=='\\' and i+1<len(s): cur.append(s[i+1]); i+=2; continue
            if c==state: state=None
        else:
            if c in ('"',"'"):
                state=c; cur.append(c)
            elif c=='(': par+=1; cur.append(c)
            elif c==')': par-=1; cur.append(c)
            elif c=='[': br+=1; cur.append(c)
            elif c==']': br-=1; cur.append(c)
            elif c.isspace() and par==0 and br==0:
                if cur: words.append(''.join(cur)); cur=[]
            else: cur.append(c)
        i+=1
    if cur: words.append(''.join(cur))
    return words

def top_level_items(body, base_offset=0):
    items=[]; i=0; n=len(body)
    while i<n:
        while i<n and body[i].isspace(): i+=1
        if i>=n: break
        start=i; par=br=0; state=None
        while i<n:
            c=body[i]
            if state:
                if c=='\\': i+=2; continue
                if c==state: state=None
                i+=1; continue
            if c in ('"',"'"):
                state=c; i+=1; continue
            if c=='(': par+=1
            elif c==')': par-=1
            elif c=='[': br+=1
            elif c==']': br-=1
            elif c==';' and par==0 and br==0:
                items.append((body[start:i+1], base_offset+start)); i+=1; break
            elif c=='{' and par==0 and br==0:
                end=find_matching(body,i,'{','}')
                if end is None:
                    items.append((body[start:], base_offset+start)); i=n; break
                j=end+1
                while j<n and body[j].isspace(): j+=1
                if j<n and body[j]==';': j+=1
                items.append((body[start:j], base_offset+start)); i=j; break
            i+=1
        else:
            if body[start:].strip(): items.append((body[start:], base_offset+start))
    return items

def strip_initializer(stmt):
    parts=split_top(stmt, '=')
    return parts[0]

def parse_mapping(t):
    t=t.strip()
    if not t.startswith('mapping'):
        return None
    p=t.find('(')
    if p<0: return None
    q=find_matching(t,p,'(',')')
    if q is None: return None
    inside=t[p+1:q]
    # split on top-level =>
    par=br=0; idx=-1; i=0
    while i < len(inside)-1:
        c=inside[i]
        if c=='(': par+=1
        elif c==')': par-=1
        elif c=='[': br+=1
        elif c==']': br-=1
        elif c=='=' and inside[i+1]=='>' and par==0 and br==0:
            idx=i; break
        i+=1
    if idx<0: return None
    return inside[:idx].strip(), inside[idx+2:].strip()

class Contract:
    def __init__(self, source, kind, name, bases, body, body_offset, key):
        self.source=source; self.kind=kind; self.name=name; self.bases=bases; self.body=body; self.body_offset=body_offset; self.key=key
        self.structs={}; self.enums={}; self.own=[]; self.index=0

class SourceUnit:
    def __init__(self, path, display, content):
        self.path=path; self.display=display; self.content=content; self.stripped=strip_comments(content); self.contracts=[]; self.aliases={}

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, sources):
        self.sources=sources
        self.contracts_by_name={}
        self.contracts_by_key={}
        self.aliases={}
        self.contract_names=set()

    def collect(self):
        for su in self.sources:
            for m in re.finditer(r'\btype\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s+is\s+([^;]+);', su.stripped):
                su.aliases[m.group(1)] = m.group(2).strip()
                self.aliases[m.group(1)] = m.group(2).strip()
            for m in re.finditer(r'\b(contract|interface|library)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)([^{};]*)\{', su.stripped):
                kind,name,rest=m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3)
                open_idx=m.end()-1
                close=find_matching(su.stripped,open_idx,'{','}')
                if close is None:
                    raise Diagnostic("expected contract item (function, variable, struct, or modifier definition), found `<eof>`", su.display, max(0,len(su.content)-1), len(su.content), su.content, note="for a full list of valid contract items, see <https://docs.soliditylang.org/en/latest/grammar.html#a4.SolidityParser.contractBodyElement>")
                bases=[]
                bm=re.search(r'\bis\b(.+)', rest)
                if bm:
                    for b in split_top(bm.group(1)):
                        bw=split_words(b.strip())
                        if bw:
                            bases.append(re.split(r'\(', bw[0])[0])
                body=su.stripped[open_idx+1:close]
                c=Contract(su,kind,name,bases,body,open_idx+1,f"{su.display}:{name}")
                su.contracts.append(c)
                self.contracts_by_name.setdefault(name,c)
                self.contracts_by_key[c.key]=c
                self.contract_names.add(name)
        for c in list(self.contracts_by_key.values()):
            self.parse_contract(c)

    def parse_contract(self,c):
        items=top_level_items(c.body,c.body_offset)
        # First pass structs/enums
        for item,off in items:
            st=item.strip()
            if st.startswith('struct '):
                m=re.match(r'struct\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\{(.*)\}\s*;?\s*$', st, re.S)
                if m:
                    fields=[]
                    for f in split_top(m.group(2), ';'):
                        f=f.strip()
                        if not f: continue
                        words=split_words(f)
                        if len(words)>=2:
                            fields.append((' '.join(words[:-1]), words[-1]))
                    c.structs[m.group(1)]=fields
            elif st.startswith('enum '):
                m=re.match(r'enum\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\{(.*?)\}', st, re.S)
                if m:
                    vals=[x.strip() for x in m.group(2).split(',') if x.strip()]
                    c.enums[m.group(1)] = max(1,len(vals))
        # Second pass ABI items
        idx=0
        for item,off in items:
            st=item.strip()
            if not st or st.startswith(('struct ','enum ','modifier ','using ','pragma ','import ')):
                continue
            try:
                made = self.parse_item(c, st, off)
                for abi in made:
                    abi['_idx']=idx; idx+=1; c.own.append(abi)
            except Diagnostic:
                raise
            except Exception:
                # Silently skip syntax we do not model; Solar's parser accepts much more than this shim.
                pass

    def parse_item(self,c,st,off):
        if st.startswith('event '):
            m=re.match(r'event\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(', st)
            if not m: return []
            p=st.find('(',m.end()-1); q=find_matching(st,p,'(',')')
            params=self.parse_params(st[p+1:q], c, event=True)
            return [{"type":"event","name":m.group(1),"inputs":params,"anonymous": bool(re.search(r'\banonymous\b', st[q+1:]))}]
        if st.startswith('error '):
            m=re.match(r'error\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(', st)
            if not m: return []
            p=st.find('(',m.end()-1); q=find_matching(st,p,'(',')')
            return [{"type":"error","name":m.group(1),"inputs":self.parse_params(st[p+1:q], c)}]
        if st.startswith('constructor'):
            p=st.find('('); q=find_matching(st,p,'(',')')
            rest=st[q+1:]
            return [{"type":"constructor","inputs":self.parse_params(st[p+1:q], c),"stateMutability":"payable" if re.search(r'\bpayable\b', rest) else "nonpayable"}]
        if st.startswith('receive'):
            return [{"type":"receive","stateMutability":"payable" if re.search(r'\bpayable\b', st) else "nonpayable"}]
        if st.startswith('fallback'):
            return [{"type":"fallback","stateMutability":"payable" if re.search(r'\bpayable\b', st) else "nonpayable"}]
        if st.startswith('function '):
            return self.parse_function(c,st,off)
        return self.parse_variable(c,st)

    def parse_function(self,c,st,off):
        m=re.match(r'function\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(', st)
        if not m: return []
        name=m.group(1); p=st.find('(', m.start()); q=find_matching(st,p,'(',')')
        params=st[p+1:q]
        rest=st[q+1:]
        vis = re.search(r'\b(public|external|private|internal)\b', rest)
        if not vis and c.kind != 'interface':
            start = off + st.find('function')
            end = start + len(st.split('{',1)[0].strip())
            raise Diagnostic("no visibility specified", c.source.display, start, min(end, len(c.source.content)), c.source.content, help_msg="add `public` to the declaration")
        if vis and vis.group(1) in ('private','internal'):
            return []
        sm='nonpayable'
        if re.search(r'\bpayable\b', rest): sm='payable'
        elif re.search(r'\bpure\b', rest): sm='pure'
        elif re.search(r'\b(view|constant)\b', rest): sm='view'
        outputs=[]
        rm=re.search(r'\breturns\s*\(', rest)
        if rm:
            rp=rest.find('(', rm.start()); rq=find_matching(rest,rp,'(',')')
            if rq is not None: outputs=self.parse_params(rest[rp+1:rq], c)
        return [{"type":"function","name":name,"inputs":self.parse_params(params,c),"outputs":outputs,"stateMutability":sm}]

    def parse_variable(self,c,st):
        if '(' in st.split(';',1)[0] and not st.strip().startswith('mapping'):
            return []
        decl=strip_initializer(st).strip().rstrip(';').strip()
        words=split_words(decl)
        if 'public' not in words: return []
        mods={'public','private','internal','constant','immutable','override','transient'}
        try: first_mod=min(i for i,w in enumerate(words) if w in mods)
        except ValueError: return []
        if first_mod == 0 or not words: return []
        name=None
        for w in reversed(words[first_mod+1:]):
            if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*', w) and w not in mods:
                name=w; break
        if not name: return []
        type_str=' '.join(words[:first_mod])
        inputs, outputs = self.getter_io(type_str,c)
        return [{"type":"function","name":name,"inputs":inputs,"outputs":outputs,"stateMutability":"view"}]

    def parse_params(self,s,c,event=False):
        res=[]
        for part in split_top(s):
            part=part.strip()
            if not part: continue
            indexed=False
            words=split_words(part)
            if event and 'indexed' in words:
                indexed=True; words=[w for w in words if w!='indexed']
            # remove data locations and parameter-only modifiers
            filtered=[]
            for w in words:
                if w in ('memory','calldata','storage'):
                    continue
                filtered.append(w)
            words=filtered
            if not words: continue
            name=''
            type_words=words
            last=words[-1]
            if len(words)>=2 and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*', last) and last not in ('payable',):
                # Most two-token declarations have a name; single-token declarations are unnamed.
                type_words=words[:-1]; name=last
            type_str=' '.join(type_words)
            entry=self.abi_param(type_str,c,name)
            if event:
                # event key order: name,type,indexed,internalType,(components)
                new={"name":entry.get('name',''),"type":entry['type'],"indexed":indexed,"internalType":entry['internalType']}
                if 'components' in entry: new['components']=entry['components']
                entry=new
            res.append(entry)
        return res

    def abi_param(self,type_str,c,name=''):
        info=self.canonical_type(type_str,c)
        d={"name":name,"type":info['type'],"internalType":info['internalType']}
        if info.get('components') is not None:
            d['components']=info['components']
        return d

    def canonical_type(self,type_str,c):
        t=' '.join(type_str.strip().split())
        t=re.sub(r'\s*\[\s*([^\]]*)\s*\]', lambda m:'['+m.group(1).strip()+']', t)
        # array suffix
        suffix=''
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'(\[[^\]]*\])\s*$', t)
            if not m: break
            suffix=m.group(1)+suffix
            t=t[:m.start()].strip()
        if t in ('uint','int'):
            base=t+'256'; internal=base
            return {"type":base+suffix,"internalType":internal+suffix}
        if re.fullmatch(r'u?int\d+', t):
            return {"type":t+suffix,"internalType":t+suffix}
        if re.fullmatch(r'bytes\d+', t) or t in ('bool','address','string','bytes'):
            return {"type":t+suffix,"internalType":t+suffix}
        if t == 'address payable':
            return {"type":"address"+suffix,"internalType":"address payable"+suffix}
        if t in c.structs:
            comps=[self.abi_param(ft,c,fn) for ft,fn in c.structs[t]]
            return {"type":"tuple"+suffix,"internalType":f"struct {c.name}.{t}"+suffix,"components":comps}
        if '.' in t:
            short=t.split('.')[-1]
            owner=t.split('.')[0]
            cc=self.contracts_by_name.get(owner,c)
            if short in cc.structs:
                comps=[self.abi_param(ft,cc,fn) for ft,fn in cc.structs[short]]
                return {"type":"tuple"+suffix,"internalType":f"struct {owner}.{short}"+suffix,"components":comps}
            if short in cc.enums:
                return {"type":"uint8"+suffix,"internalType":f"enum {owner}.{short}"+suffix}
        if t in c.enums:
            return {"type":"uint8"+suffix,"internalType":f"enum {c.name}.{t}"+suffix}
        if t in self.aliases:
            base=self.canonical_type(self.aliases[t],c)
            return {"type":base['type']+suffix,"internalType":t+suffix}
        if t in self.contract_names:
            return {"type":"address"+suffix,"internalType":f"contract {t}"+suffix}
        # Unknown user type: Solidity contract/interface types ABI-encode as address in many common cases.
        if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*', t):
            return {"type":"address"+suffix,"internalType":f"contract {t}"+suffix}
        return {"type":t.replace(' ','')+suffix,"internalType":t+suffix}

    def getter_io(self,type_str,c):
        inputs=[]
        def rec(t):
            mp=parse_mapping(t)
            if mp:
                k,v=mp
                inputs.append(self.abi_param(k,c,''))
                return rec(v)
            # array public getter indexes one dimension, except bytes/string are scalar
            arr_suffixes=[]; base=t.strip()
            while True:
                m=re.search(r'(\[[^\]]*\])\s*$', base)
                if not m: break
                arr_suffixes.append(m.group(1)); base=base[:m.start()].strip()
            if arr_suffixes and base not in ('bytes','string'):
                inputs.append(self.abi_param('uint256',c,''))
                # public getter returns element with one dimension removed
                return rec(base + ''.join(reversed(arr_suffixes[1:])))
            info=self.canonical_type(t,c)
            if info['type'].startswith('tuple') and info.get('components'):
                return [comp.copy() for comp in info['components']]
            return [self.abi_param(t,c,'')]
        return inputs, rec(type_str)

    def inherited_items(self,c,seen=None):
        if seen is None: seen=set()
        if c.name in seen: return []
        seen.add(c.name)
        items=[]
        for b in c.bases:
            bc=self.contracts_by_name.get(b)
            if bc:
                items.extend(self.inherited_items(bc,seen))
                for it in bc.own:
                    if it['type'] != 'constructor': items.append(it)
        items.extend(c.own)
        # Dedupe identical ABI items, keeping later overrides for functions by signature.
        out=[]; seen_keys=set()
        for it in reversed(items):
            key=self.item_key(it)
            if key in seen_keys: continue
            seen_keys.add(key); out.append(it)
        return list(reversed(out))

    def item_key(self,it):
        if it['type']=='function': return ('function', it['name'], tuple(sig_type(x) for x in it.get('inputs',[])))
        if it['type'] in ('event','error'): return (it['type'], it.get('name'), tuple(sig_type(x) for x in it.get('inputs',[])))
        return (it['type'],)

    def abi_for(self,c):
        items=self.inherited_items(c)
        cats={'constructor':[], 'error':[], 'event':[], 'fallback':[], 'function':[], 'receive':[]}
        for it in items:
            clean={k:v for k,v in it.items() if not k.startswith('_')}
            cats.get(clean['type'],[]).append((it.get('_idx',0),clean))
        result=[]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['constructor'], key=lambda p:p[0])]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['error'], key=lambda p:(p[1].get('name',''), p[0]))]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['event'], key=lambda p:(p[1].get('name',''), p[0]))]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['fallback'], key=lambda p:p[0])]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['function'], key=lambda p:(p[1].get('name',''), p[0]))]
        result += [x for _,x in sorted(cats['receive'], key=lambda p:p[0])]
        return result

    def hashes_for(self,c):
        h={}
        for it in self.abi_for(c):
            if it.get('type') != 'function': continue
            sig=it['name']+'('+','.join(sig_type(x) for x in it.get('inputs',[]))+')'
            h[sig]=keccak256(sig.encode()).hex()[:8]
        return OrderedDict((k,h[k]) for k in sorted(h))

def sig_type(param):
    typ=param['type']
    if typ.startswith('tuple'):
        suffix=typ[len('tuple'):]
        return '('+','.join(sig_type(c) for c in param.get('components',[]))+')'+suffix
    return typ

def norm_abs(p): return os.path.abspath(os.path.normpath(p))

def display_path(path, opts):
    if path == '<stdin>': return '<stdin>'
    ap=norm_abs(path)
    bases=[]
    if opts.base_path: bases.append(norm_abs(opts.base_path))
    bases.append(os.getcwd())
    for b in bases:
        try:
            rel=os.path.relpath(ap,b)
            if not rel.startswith('..'+os.sep) and rel != '..':
                return rel.replace(os.sep,'/')
        except Exception:
            pass
    return ap.replace(os.sep,'/')

def apply_remap(imp, opts):
    for pref,target in opts.remappings:
        if imp.startswith(pref):
            return target + imp[len(pref):]
    return imp

def resolve_import(imp, from_path, opts):
    rem=apply_remap(imp,opts)
    cands=[]
    if os.path.isabs(rem): cands.append(rem)
    else:
        if from_path and from_path != '<stdin>':
            cands.append(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(from_path), rem))
        else:
            cands.append(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), rem))
        for inc in opts.include_paths:
            cands.append(os.path.join(inc, rem))
        if opts.base_path: cands.append(os.path.join(opts.base_path, rem))
    for c in cands:
        if os.path.exists(c): return norm_abs(c)
    return None

def import_spans(src):
    stripped=strip_comments(src)
    for m in re.finditer(r'\bimport\s+(?:(?:[^;]*?)\s+from\s+)?["\']([^"\']+)["\']', stripped):
        yield m.group(1), m.start(1), m.end(1)

def load_sources(opts):
    loaded=OrderedDict()
    stdin_loaded=False
    def load_file(path, display_override=None):
        nonlocal stdin_loaded
        if path == '-':
            key='<stdin>'
            if stdin_loaded: return
            stdin_loaded=True
            content=sys.stdin.read()
            su=SourceUnit('<stdin>','<stdin>',content)
            loaded[key]=su
        else:
            ap=norm_abs(path)
            if ap in loaded: return
            if not os.path.exists(ap):
                raise Diagnostic(f"file {path} not found")
            with open(ap,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f: content=f.read()
            su=SourceUnit(ap, display_override or display_path(ap,opts), content)
            loaded[ap]=su
        if opts.no_resolve_imports: return
        cur=list(loaded.values())[-1]
        for imp,st,en in import_spans(cur.content):
            rp=resolve_import(imp, None if cur.path=='<stdin>' else cur.path, opts)
            if not rp:
                raise Diagnostic(f"file {imp} not found", cur.display, st, en, cur.content)
            load_file(rp)
    for inp in opts.inputs:
        load_file(inp)
    return list(loaded.values())

def compile_to_json(opts):
    sources=load_sources(opts)
    parser=Parser(sources); parser.collect()
    contracts=OrderedDict()
    for key in sorted(parser.contracts_by_key):
        c=parser.contracts_by_key[key]
        obj=OrderedDict()
        if 'abi' in opts.emit:
            obj['abi']=parser.abi_for(c)
        if 'hashes' in opts.emit:
            obj['hashes']=parser.hashes_for(c)
        contracts[key]=obj
    return OrderedDict([('contracts',contracts),('version',VERSION)])

def main(argv):
    opts=parse_args(argv)
    try:
        result=compile_to_json(opts)
        if opts.emit:
            text=json.dumps(result, indent=2 if opts.pretty_json else None, separators=None if opts.pretty_json else (',',':'))

                try:
                    with open(os.path.join(opts.out_dir,'combined.json'),'w',encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(text)
                except OSError as e:
                    raise Diagnostic(f"failed to write to output: {e.strerror} (os error {e.errno})")
            else:
                sys.stdout.write(text)
        return 0
    except Diagnostic as d:
        emit_diagnostics([d], opts)
        return 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
